properties.description: The tests that carry the weight are the refusals: no criterion reads as "no closure criterion stated" rather than as any default, and a counted leg with nothing to run on cannot read as closed. Fixture is delivery.rs's threaded design.
properties.name: a_design_closes_against_a_declared_threshold.rs — nine cases: no criterion is never a default, an unknown leg is refused by name, a delivered thread closes and a failing check reopens it, a counted leg with nothing to run on cannot read as closed, 50% is legal, margin, declared order, the decisions hole, the release report carries the verdict
